interaction.author: human
interaction.user_prompt: yes, commit and open the PR

tool_executions.arguments:
{"command":"git add -A && git status --short && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Show errors, recover from unreadable directories, handle symlinks

- Report every error through reportError: a status-bar toast that
  expires after 5s plus an error log (Alt+L). Errors used to be stored
  in m.err and never rendered, so a failed copy or delete looked like
  success. Panes now reload after a partially failed copy, move or
  delete.
- Navigate only once a listing succeeds: loadDirectoryCmd takes the
  target path and the pane moves there on success. Entering an
  unreadable directory used to strand the pane with no entries and no
  way up; now it stays put and the error is shown. A failed reload of
  the current directory still offers "..".
- Resolve symlinks in readDirectory: a link to a directory is entered
  like one (shown with an "@" suffix). Delete removes the link, never
  its target; copy recreates links as links, also inside copied trees.
- Refuse to copy or move a file onto itself under another name (a hard
  link, or a symlink on either side), which truncated the original.
- Mark the fixed rows in the roadmap and document the error and
  navigation conventions in CLAUDE.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git push -u origin render-errors 2>&1 | tail -2","description":"Commit changes and push branch"}
